label: exploratory
backend: ONNX Runtime CPU, dynamic batch, one thread
interval_method: 95% percentile bootstrap; 4096 resamples of whole shared serve seeds, retaining both sides, all five rallies, and every opponent together. Intervals measure serve-set uncertainty, not certainty about model ranks.
interpretation: Exploratory comparison of a fixed finite design matrix, not independent holdout evidence. The original Quill is both a baseline candidate and one of seven fixed reference opponents; its self-match is included as a draw. All candidates face exactly the same reference field and paired serve seeds. Published league rankings require separate fresh evaluation through the shared browser/WASM simulator after final model freeze.
